name: Upload
description: A field that collects files picked from the system or dropped onto it, and lists them.

label.description: Visible name of the value. Empty content leaves naming to aria-label/aria-labelledby.

description.description: Help for entering the value, announced with the focused control.

error.description: Validation message; marks the field invalid unless aria-invalid is explicit. Not a live region.

labelPosition.description: Label above the control, or at its inline start (stacks when narrow). Defaults to top.

files.description: Controlled list; an entry without a string `id`, or repeating an earlier one, is dropped.

defaultFiles.description: List on mount when `files` is not set, restored by form reset; read once.

accept.description: File types the picker offers and a drop accepts, as the native accept: `image/*`, `.pdf`, `text/csv`.

multiple.description: Lets the list hold several files; without it a new file replaces the listed one.

maxSize.description: Largest accepted file in bytes; omitted means no limit.

maxFiles.description: Most files the list holds with `multiple`; omitted means no limit.

disabled.description: Stops picking, dropping and removing, and leaves the files out of form submission.

name.description: FormData key under which the listed browser files are submitted.

form.description: Id of the form that submits and resets the files, when it is not an ancestor.

required.description: Blocks form submission while the list is empty and marks the label.

autoFocus.description: Focuses the button that opens the file picker on mount.

aria-label.description: Names the group when there is no visible `label`.

aria-labelledby.description: Ids of the elements that name the group; they win over `label` and `aria-label`.

labels.description: Strings Upload renders itself: the drop instruction, the button names and the rejection messages.

behavior.dropTarget: The whole field takes file drags; other drags are left to the browser.

notes: Name the group with label, aria-label or aria-labelledby; description and error describe the group and the choose button.
The native file input is hidden from assistive tech and the tab order; remove buttons are named by labels.remove with the file name, and an entry's error describes its remove button.
An entry's progress bar is named by the file name.
Label, description and error come from the shared Field; the hint, file names and sizes render through Text, the picker and remove actions through Button, progress through Progress.
accept, maxSize, maxFiles and file metadata are validation and product data, outside visual token ownership.

whenToUse: Collecting product or profile images with upload progress
whenNotToUse: Choosing among stored files (use Select or a list)
